title: Converge Node
description: Synchronization point that waits for all parallel branches to complete before proceeding.

parameterSchema.description: Converge configuration controls how parallel branches are synchronized

strategy.description: Convergence strategy: 'all' waits for all branches, 'any' waits for n_required branches

n_required.description: Number of branches required before convergence (only used when strategy is 'any')

wait_duration.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for branches to arrive before timing out. Falls back to the system-configured default if not specified.

resultSchema.description: Result structure available in result namespace (discriminated union)

branch_count.description: Total number of incoming parallel branches

completed_count.description: Number of branches that completed before convergence triggered. Equals branch_count for 'all' strategy.

completed_branch_node_ids.description: Node IDs of completed branches. Users can reference these nodes directly for outputs (e.g., ${task_a.result}).

oneOf.title: Failed Result
oneOf.description: All executor fields are present but nullable. A null value means the failure occurred before that field was available.
